blocks.x: CPG brands compete on shelf, on shelf-image and on data: trade spend efficiency, retail execution truth, demand signal quality and now provenance claims. The brands that win industrialize the sell-side data relationship with retailers.

The workflows we industrialize here: Trade promotion management, Demand planning, Retail execution, Provenance claims, Brand protection. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Retailer portals and EDI produce a patchwork; trade-spend ROI is estimated.
Promotions, distribution changes and retail signals confuse planners; forecast error compounds.
Sustainability/origin claims face EUDR/DPP scrutiny; evidence manual.
Retail-execution teams run route lists without shelf-truth priority; OOS persists.
TPM platforms resist modeling; spend decisions legacy.
Counterfeiting and diverted goods untracked; digital brand risk unmanaged.

blocks.x: How we help — five priority capabilities

items: retailer feeds harmonized for trade and demand analytics — trade ROI real
promo uplift modeling with causal design — spend redirected
EUDR-grade chain-of-custody for claim SKUs — claims verified
shelf-truth events routed to field teams — OOS on priority SKUs down

blocks.x: A typical program here starts with a two-week diagnostic that measures the workflows named above and locks the baseline, moves through a gated proof on your data, then industrializes on platform rails with the sector's compliance evidence generated in-flight.

items: Fresh waste down 28%, OOS down 31% — day-part demand and ordering agents
